purpose: Install previously missing first visual learner cards from approved Master Plant Pool with individually rights-checked one-photo provisional galleries
selection_guards: Current manifest, claims, dated preflight queue and Batch 011 reservations checked. Exact accepted species name required. Taxonomy rank and possible synonyms in preflight. No county-native gate. Archive photo-library index has zero stored images for these exact species, so licensed iNaturalist fallback.

selected.look_here_first: Look for alternate pinnate leaves bearing multiple pointed leaflets, red-to-blue small drupes in clusters and smooth gray bark on young trunks.
Inspect small opposite oval leaves and solitary five-lobed flowers on slender axillary stalks, with round capsules after flowering; flower color varies.
Inspect hairy stems and three-lobed lower leaves; small glossy yellow five-petaled flowers followed by a rounded head of achenes.
Moist-site herb with divided or lobed leaves, small yellow flowers and a long cylindrical cluster of many small achenes.
Observe small four-petaled yellow mustard flowers and distinctly two-parted fruit with a swollen upper segment; inspect leaves and fruiting stems.
Small wet-ground herb with opposite narrow leaves, four-parted tiny flowers in leaf axils and capsule fruits; inspect flower calyx close up.
Inspect opposite narrow leaves, slender upright branches, small pink five-petaled flowers and a sticky band beneath the upper stem nodes.
Climbing woody vine with tendrils arising near leaf stalks; inspect bristly or prickly stems, broad leaves and berries in umbels.
Mat-forming creeping plant with opposite thickened leaves that may be three-lobed and solitary yellow daisy-like heads; inspect rooting nodes.
Low spreading annual legume with leaves of three small leaflets, inconspicuous pinkish pea flowers and flattened one-seeded pods.
Small tufted sedge with mostly leafless round stems, each topped by a solitary compact spikelet; inspect achene and bristle features.
Slender finely dissected ferny leaves and very small white flowers in compound umbels; look closely at the tiny ribbed two-part fruits.
